resources.string: Clear this app’s saved hosts and sign-ins?

This closes every open host view and clears ALL saved hosts, saved passwords and pairing tokens, host cookies, sign-ins, origin-local drafts and view storage, and cached web data in this app. Host-owned sessions and processes are not deleted or stopped. This cannot be undone.
Clearing all saved hosts and sign-ins… Reconnect is disabled until deletion is complete.
All saved hosts, saved sign-ins, host cookies, and local drafts and view storage in this app were cleared. Connect to sign in again. Host sessions are unchanged.
Update Android System WebView or Chrome to clear all local data safely. This provider does not support confirmed browsing-data deletion. No local data, saved host, or saved sign-in has been removed.
Local-data removal did not complete. Update Android System WebView or Chrome and try Clear saved hosts and sign-ins again. Reconnect remains disabled to prevent old data from being restored.
Sign in on the host\'s page or when this app asks. Saved passwords and pairing tokens stay encrypted on this device.
Saved encrypted on this device and used when this host asks you to sign in.
Saved hosts is full (16). Remove one to save %1$s.
This forgets the saved address and its saved sign-in. The host\'s sign-in cookie and drafts stay in this app until you use Clear saved hosts and sign-ins.
The saved password for %1$s was rejected and forgotten. Enter it again to save it.
The saved pairing token for %1$s was rejected and forgotten. Paste a fresh pairing link.
Too many sign-in attempts on %1$s. Try again later.
Could not reach %1$s to sign in.
Closed the hidden view of %1$s to save memory. It reloads when you pick it.
The web view restarted. Restoring your host view; unsent attachments must be selected again. Other open hosts reload when you pick them.
